name: vue-starter
description: Minimal Vue.js integration for a Webrium project: a second Vite entry, a placeholder component, a controller and layout to mount it, wired together as a working example. Not an admin panel or any other real feature — just proof that Vue is set up correctly, ready for you to build on.
author: Webrium
post_install_message:
<options=bold>Finish setting up vue-starter:</>

  1. npm install vue @vitejs/plugin-vue
  2. Wire vue() + the 'vue-demo' entry into vite.config.js
  3. Add the /vue-demo route

Full details (exact before/after diffs) are in <options=bold>VUE-STARTER-SETUP.md</> at your project root — also written so an AI coding assistant can carry them out directly. Delete it once done.
